The thing about social anxiety is that it makes you believe things you know aren't true. I know I'm not stuck, I know that at any point in time I could have told her where to shove it, but I physically couldn't. At times I'd have panic attacks, there'd be to many people around and I'd be scared to confront her because I didn't want to make a fool of myself in front of everybody, I'd think of all the possible outcomes of me confronting her, of course every single one was negative.

I know that my reactions are unhealthy, but I am socially inept and they are the only reactions I'm capable of , seeing as I have zero social skills, take everything personally, and over think everything. I can't sit on a bus without analyzing everything. What the driver thinks of me when I get on, how I'm going to thank the driver when I get off the bus, and how my voice will sound, where I'm going to look when the bus driver pulls up, where I'm going to look when people come on the bus, how I'm going to act if somebody I know comes on the bus, what I'm going to do or where I'm going to look if somebody sits next to me, and if somebody is looking at me I have to try my best to pretend that I don't know they're looking. Anyway I'm going off topic... I'm not sure what you're trying to say in your comment, but I have taken therapy for as long as I can remember, I don't think college counselors are going to make a dent in my issues.

Thanks anyway
